title: RIFT: KV Cache Compression for Draft Models with Complementary Compressibility Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.31098v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speculative decoding is a popular decode acceleration method. As such, it is particularly relevant to long-output generation, which requires an increasingly large KV cache. KV cache compression offers a way to constrain costs in long-context drafting. However, compression methods that focus on prefill information can lose relevance as the output length grows. We term this phenomenon decode staleness and show that it degrades draft model accuracy under selection-based KV cache compression. We introduce RIFT, a family of selection-based KV cache compression strategies that balance prefill information and recent generated tokens. We show that refreshing the KV cache selection during token generation significantly improves the drafter's quality at the cost of additional decode latency. To alleviate the refresh costs, we propose an adaptive KV refresh strategy that reduces the number of score calculations while retaining the drafter's quality

translated_title: RIFT：面向草稿模型的KV缓存压缩方法与互补可压缩性训练
translated_abstract: 投机解码是一种流行的解码加速方法，因此它对于需要越来越大的KV缓存的长输出生成尤为重要。KV缓存压缩提供了一种约束长上下文草稿生成成本的手段。然而，专注于预填充信息的压缩方法会随着输出长度的增长而逐渐失去相关性。我们将这种现象称为“解码陈旧性”，并证明该现象在基于选择的KV缓存压缩下会降低草稿模型的准确率。我们提出了RIFT，这是一系列基于选择的KV缓存压缩策略，能够平衡预填充信息与最近生成的token。我们证明在token生成过程中刷新KV缓存的选择可以显著提升草稿模型的质量，但代价是额外的解码延迟。为了缓解刷新带来的开销，我们提出了一种自适应KV刷新策略，在保持草稿模型质量的同时减少了评分计算的次数。
tldr: RIFT提出了一类基于选择的KV缓存压缩策略，通过在token生成过程中动态刷新KV缓存选择来应对“解码陈旧性”问题，并借助自适应刷新策略在保持草稿模型质量的同时显著降低刷新开销。
en_tdlr: RIFT introduces a family of selection-based KV cache compression strategies that combat decode staleness by refreshing KV cache selection during token generation, with an adaptive refresh strategy that reduces score computation overhead while maintaining draft model quality.
